subject: geography
title: The UK Climate
welcome_lead: Why is Britain famous for rain and mild weather? The UK has a temperate maritime climate. Find out why!
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on the UK's temperate maritime climate.
final_note: Excellent! You now know why the UK is mild and wet.

concepts.def: Mild, not too hot or too cold.

walkthroughs.body_html: The UK is warmed by the Gulf Stream, a current of warm water from the Caribbean. Without it, our winters would be far colder!
The UK's prevailing wind comes from the south-west, blowing moist air from the Atlantic. This air rises over hills and falls as rain — that's why the west is wetter.
Northern Scotland is cooler and wetter; the south-east is warmer and drier. Altitude and distance from sea both matter.

mcqs.q: Why is GDP per capita a poor measure of wellbeing?
options: GDP measures the total wealth of every individual in a country.
GDP measures economic activity, not wellbeing. It ignores inequality, unpaid work, environmental damage and quality of life — high GDP can coexist with poor health, education or happiness.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
A high GDP per capita means citizens are happy and well off.

mcqs.q: Why is 'renewable' not the same as 'clean' energy?
options: Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
All renewable energy sources are clean and have no environmental impact.
GDP measures the total wealth of every individual in a country.

Renewable means the source replenishes naturally on human timescales; clean means low environmental/health impact. Hydropower is renewable but floods habitats; bioenergy is renewable but can drive deforestation.

mcqs.q: Why is a food web a better model than a food chain?
options: GDP measures the total wealth of every individual in a country.
A food chain shows one linear path; a food web shows the many interconnected feeding relationships in reality, so it better represents how species depend on multiple food sources.
A food web shows what spiders eat and a food chain shows what other animals eat.
A food web is the same as a food chain, just drawn differently.
